# Vendored libraries

Copied unchanged from the npm registry on 2026-09-23. They are served from this site because
SPEC §0 `NO SERVER` allows the built site no origin besides the configured endpoint, the GitHub
API and the local bridge. A CDN would be a fourth origin.

| File | Package | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `marked.esm.js` | `marked` (`lib/marked.esm.js`) | 18.0.14 | MIT (`LICENSE.marked`) |
| `purify.es.mjs` | `dompurify` (`dist/purify.es.mjs`) | 3.4.16 | MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE.dompurify`) |
| `mermaid.min.js` | `mermaid` (`dist/mermaid.min.js`) | 12.0.0 | MIT (`LICENSE.mermaid`) |

Updating: `npm pack <name>@<version>`, copy the same file, change the table.
